payout_quote: When you join BECU and meet transaction requirements, you could earn $1 for every home run the Mariners hit during the regular season! Join using promo code HOMERUN before Sep. 30, 2026.
steps: Join BECU using promo code HOMERUN before September 30, 2026 - open a checking and savings account online or in person
Complete 10 or more qualifying transactions (debit/credit card purchases, checks, deposits, withdrawals) within the first 30 days of joining
Receive $1 for every regular-season Mariners home run - minimum $150, maximum $250 - deposited into your account after the season ends
catches: Promo code HOMERUN must be used and joining must happen before September 30, 2026
Requires 10+ qualifying transactions within the first 30 days of membership
Payout amount depends on the number of Mariners regular-season home runs ($1 each); guaranteed floor is $150, cap is $250
Bonus is paid after the season ends - you wait until fall for the payout
BECU membership eligibility applies (Pacific Northwest footprint - WA, OR, ID counties, Boeing employees, etc.)
Full transaction-requirement footnotes (1, 2, 3, 4) apply on the official page
biggest_catch: The exact bonus amount depends on how many home runs the Mariners hit - you are guaranteed at least $150 but the top end is $250, and the money does not arrive until the season is over.
eligibility: New BECU members within BECU's field of membership (WA, OR, ID counties, Boeing employees, etc.); join with promo code HOMERUN by 9/30/2026.
timing: Join by 9/30/2026; complete 10+ qualifying transactions within the first 30 days; bonus deposited after the regular season ends.
